description:
Tall, graceful, and packed with storage, the Addison Chest Dresser is a beautiful solution for organizing your nursery. With dovetailed drawers that glide smoothly on full-extension hardware, this chest keeps clothes, blankets, and accessories neatly organized and easy to access.

The solid hardwood construction and rich Brown Maple finish ensure it will last through every stage of childhood. Compact footprint makes it ideal for smaller nurseries. Non-toxic, baby-safe finish.

Complements the full Addison collection seamlessly.

If you would like help choosing a finish, confirming timing, or picturing how this piece fits your nursery plans, use Get Personal Assistance. We reply the same or next business day so you can decide with full information, at your own pace.
